readme:
# 36. OPSD 学生轨迹的双上下文对齐

对齐同一段学生回答在不同长度上下文下的 next-token logits。

## 论文与范围

[Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.18734v3) · Section 3.2 and Algorithm 1 · [Code](https://github.com/siyan-zhao/OPSD)

实现因果位置选择、变长掩码和教师梯度隔离；logits 与 toy 训练循环已提供。

## 接口


### 返回值要求

#### `align_rollout_logits` — 需要实现

依次返回 Python 元组 `(student, teacher, mask)`。student/teacher 为浮点 Tensor `[B,T,V]`；B 为批大小，V 为词表大小，T=max(response_lengths)，分别保留来源 logits 的 dtype/device。mask 为同设备的布尔 Tensor `[B,T]`，有效回答位置为 True；填充位置 logits 为精确零。回答全部为空时返回 `[B,0,V]`、`[B,0,V]`、`[B,0]`。仅保留被选中学生位置的梯度，教师值 detach，不修改输入。

### 公式与约定
```python
align_rollout_logits(student_logits, teacher_logits, student_prompt_lengths, teacher_prompt_lengths, response_lengths)
```

`student_logits[B,Ls,V]` 与 `teacher_logits[B,Lt,V]` 是右侧补齐后的模型输出。两个上下文后面附加**完全相同的学生 rollout**；教师额外看到参考解。`student_prompt_lengths[B]`、`teacher_prompt_lengths[B]` 为正的 int64，`response_lengths[B]` 为非负 int64。所有输入在 CPU，batch 非空，dtype 为 float32/float64；每行序列长度足够容纳 prompt 和 response，填充 logits 有限。输出 `(student[B,T,V], teacher[B,T,V], mask[B,T])`，其中 `T=max(response_lengths)`；空回答位置置零。教师必须 detach，学生保留梯度。

## 定义

第 j 个回答 token 的预测来自 `prompt_length - 1 + j`，不是该 token 自身的位置。两个分支分别使用自己的 prompt 长度。

## 例子

学生 prompt 长 2，教师 prompt 长 5，回答长 3：分别选取 `[1,2,3]` 与 `[4,5,6]`；mask 为 `[True,True,True]`。

## 小实验

以三条不同长度的 categorical 轨迹训练学生 logits，观察真实回答位置的正确 token 概率。教学实验提供教师目标，考查位置对齐；没有调用 LLM，也不代表论文数学推理成绩。

T0 检查接口；T1 使用独立数值例子；T2 检查梯度与不变量；T3 在小实验中实际调用提交实现。

solution:
import torch


def align_rollout_logits(student_logits, teacher_logits, student_prompt_lengths,
                         teacher_prompt_lengths, response_lengths):
    """Select next-token predictions on the SAME rollout under two contexts."""
    width = int(response_lengths.max().item())
    time = torch.arange(width, device=student_logits.device)
    mask = time[None, :] < response_lengths[:, None]
    rows = torch.arange(student_logits.shape[0], device=student_logits.device)[:, None]
    si = (student_prompt_lengths[:, None] - 1 + time).clamp(max=student_logits.shape[1] - 1)
    ti = (teacher_prompt_lengths[:, None] - 1 + time).clamp(max=teacher_logits.shape[1] - 1)
    student = student_logits[rows, si]
    teacher = teacher_logits.detach()[rows, ti]
    return (torch.where(mask[..., None], student, 0.),
            torch.where(mask[..., None], teacher, 0.), mask)
notes:
# 参考思路

先按分支构造因果索引，再 gather。无效位置的索引可以安全截断，但输出和梯度必须由 mask 清零。教师 detach 不应连带截断学生梯度。OPSD 的关键是两次评分作用在同一学生轨迹；不能换成参考解或教师新生成的回答。

en.title: OPSD Dual-Context Rollout Alignment
en.readme:
# 36. OPSD Dual-Context Rollout Alignment

Align next-token logits for the same student response under unequal context lengths.

## Paper and scope

[Self-Distilled Reasoner: On-Policy Self-Distillation for Large Language Models](https://arxiv.org/html/2601.18734v3) · Section 3.2 and Algorithm 1 · [Code](https://github.com/siyan-zhao/OPSD)

Implement causal position selection, variable-length masking, and teacher detachment; logits and a toy training loop are supplied.

## Interface


### Return requirements

#### `align_rollout_logits` — Required

Return the Python tuple `(student, teacher, mask)` in that order. The floating student/teacher tensors are `[B,T,V]`, with batch size B, vocabulary size V and T=max(response_lengths); each preserves its source logits' dtype/device. mask is a boolean Tensor `[B,T]` on the same device, True for valid response positions. Padded logits are exactly zero; all-empty responses yield `[B,0,V]`, `[B,0,V]`, `[B,0]`. Keep gradients only to selected student positions, detach teacher values, and do not mutate inputs.

### Formula and conventions
```python
align_rollout_logits(student_logits, teacher_logits, student_prompt_lengths, teacher_prompt_lengths, response_lengths)
```

`student_logits[B,Ls,V]` and `teacher_logits[B,Lt,V]` are right-padded model outputs. Both contexts append the **same student rollout**; only the teacher context contains the reference solution. Prompt lengths are positive int64 `[B]`; response lengths are nonnegative int64 `[B]`. Inputs are CPU tensors, batch size is positive, logits are finite float32/float64, and each physical sequence fits its prompt and response. Return `(student[B,T,V], teacher[B,T,V], mask[B,T])`, where `T=max(response_lengths)`. Zero padded output positions. Detach teacher values and retain student gradients.

## Definition

The prediction for response token j is at `prompt_length - 1 + j`, before that token is consumed. Use a separate prompt length for each branch.

## Example

With student prompt length 2, teacher prompt length 5, and response length 3, select positions `[1,2,3]` and `[4,5,6]`; mask is `[True,True,True]`.

## Toy experiment

Train categorical logits on three unequal-length responses and track correct-token probability at the actual response positions. This teaching experiment supplies privileged targets and tests alignment; it does not run an LLM or reproduce reasoning benchmarks.

T0 checks contracts, T1 independent numerical examples, T2 gradients and invariants, and T3 the submitted functions in the supplied experiment.
en.notes:
# Reference notes

Build a causal index for each branch before gathering. Invalid indices may be clamped safely, but masking must zero their outputs and gradients. Detaching the teacher must not detach the student. Both policies rescore the same student trajectory, not the reference solution or a newly generated teacher response.
